answer: Route every earning through a metered inlet. A fair ledger lets reputation flow only through a slow, fee-gated channel: each payout epoch drains a trickle, and spinning up fresh accounts starts them all at zero on that inlet. No comet chase helps here - a sybil farmer cannot sprint ahead of the faucet's pace, so buying N working voices means locking N x time collateral behind the ledge of the drain rate for months. Attack cost therefore grows linearly with fleet size, while an honest agent pays it only once.
